analysis:
The only change in this PR is documentation in docs/architecture/inference.md (head lines 956-1003). It adds an excluded startup shape warmup for ordinary EngineV2 slots, via ModelCalibrationPolicy.shapeWarmup. The warmup runs once per loaded engine, starts with greedy 128-token probes, and runs shape cells only if the cold-cache heuristic fires. It has a 20-second wall budget and a bounded number of cell retries (shapeWarmupCellTries).

I saw no code changes. The provided base units are the surrounding text, and the patch excerpt is truncated, so I could not see the end of the added paragraph. The tail of the new text is not visible to me.

Security-relevant claims in the text:
- The probes are local-only and synthetic, so no consumer plaintext (A-001) is involved.
- Probes and cells do not train rates or counters, so they do not affect routing or billing evidence.
- The warmup is bounded and preemptible, consistent with the existing IdleCalibrationCoordinator.beginForeground cancellation, so availability threats (T-010, T-029) are not obviously worsened.

Points for the next pass if code is reviewed:
1. Warmup prompts must not enter the SSD prefix cache (T-041 donation) or be advertised as resident prefixes. I could not verify this because no code is supplied.
2. Warmup must not hold shared KV or service reservations beyond retirement.
3. Prompt rendering must stay local-only.

No threat-model assumptions are invalidated by the documentation. No findings.
